project_name: Vesper Native Android TV & Reference V2 UI Parity
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / ELECTRIC V2 TV

interaction_flow.home_screen: Top Nav (12 icons) -> Hero Billboard (Autoplay 280ms trailer) -> Wide Preview Rail -> Category Shelves
interaction_flow.movie_detail: Top-left Back+Home buttons -> Title & Meta (MOVIE · TT31049299) -> Autoplay 1080p CTA -> Down to Cast Row (Hover actor updates hero bio) -> Click actor for Filmography -> Down to Similar Movies
interaction_flow.tv_series_detail: Back+Home adjacent -> Hero info -> Season Selector Pills -> Rich Episode List (Thumbnail, Title, Runtime, Overview, Watched Progress)
interaction_flow.networks_screen: Branded Network Cards featuring authentic background colors and vectors
interaction_flow.studios_and_boxsets: Identical layout to Home Screen with Hero Billboard + Wide Preview Trailer Rail

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 100% visual and layout alignment between native Android Kotlin UI and the reference V2 React web frontend.
Implement exact 12-icon top navigation with signal cyan focus state and Geist Mono labels.
Support 280ms dwell-triggered inline trailer playback on Hero Billboard, Studios, and Box Sets.
Apply authentic network brand background colors for Network tiles.
In Movie Detail, bind Cast card focus to top hero Actor Bio swap, and enable Down D-pad navigation to Filmography and Similar Movies.
In TV Show Detail, replace giant yellow logo with standard Back+Home header and rich 16:9 episode cards.
Maintain data-testid attributes on all interactive elements across JS and R.id.test_id tags in Kotlin Views.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do NOT use transition: all. Specify individual properties (transform, opacity, color).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_header: Header overlays must use backdrop-blur glassmorphism or semi-solid dark backgrounds, never transparent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous 10-foot TV UI spacing (padding/margins) to avoid text/icon collisions.
